question: Conditional on the supplied Phase-2 geometry width=1024 and depth=16, what weight and architecture law does the locally installed official WhestBench evaluator use?

answer.entry_law_before_storage_cast: W_l[i,j] = Z_lij * sqrt(2/1024), with standard_normal Z draws from the per-MLP weight RNG
answer.matrix_draw_relationship: The depth matrices are sequential standard_normal draws from one per-MLP weight RNG; no normalization, QR, identity blend, or post-draw spectral scaling occurs.

wheel_record.interpretation: The RECORD entries bind the exact installed official source file payloads listed below.

source_evidence.claim: The module identifies itself as evaluator sampling code; sample_mlp documents N(0,2/width), computes sqrt(2/width), draws a standard_normal width-by-width array for each layer, casts each to float32, and constructs MLP(width, depth, weights, seed).
The CPU dataset bake derives a dedicated weight SeedSequence stream, constructs its RNG, and calls sample_mlp(width, depth, weight_stream, ...).

The torch-backed dataset bake explicitly says it uses the same protocol as create_dataset, calls the same sample_mlp with the weight stream, and stacks the resulting weights as float32 before device transfer.
The live make_contest evaluator creates a per-MLP RNG from the weight substream and calls sample_mlp(spec.width, spec.depth, mlp_rng, ...).
The canonical MLP container has width, depth, ordered weights, seed, and name fields; there is no bias, residual, skip, or identity field.
Both final-only and all-layer official forward paths replace x by ReLU(x @ w) at each layer, with no bias, residual addition, or identity carrier.

distribution_path_reconciliation.live_make_contest: Calls the one authoritative sample_mlp law.
distribution_path_reconciliation.cpu_dataset_bake: Calls the one authoritative sample_mlp law.
distribution_path_reconciliation.torch_dataset_bake: Calls the one authoritative sample_mlp law on CPU before stacking/transferring weights.
distribution_path_reconciliation.precomputed_dataset_read: Loads already stored float32 weights and does not regenerate them. Establishing the byte-level provenance of hidden board rows would require external/private dataset authority that this audit did not access.
distribution_path_reconciliation.bounded_conclusion: All locally installed official generation pathways use iid Gaussian He weights. No local official generator supports an orthogonal, residual-identity, or scale-0.12 alternative.

rejected_hypotheses.basis: The MLP data model contains no bias/skip/identity state and the forward loop is exactly x = ReLU(x @ w).
sample_mlp performs only standard_normal, scalar multiplication by sqrt(2/width), float32 cast, and array construction; no QR or orthogonalization exists.
Official standard deviation is sqrt(2/1024)=0.04419417382415922, not 0.12.
sample_mlp and each evaluator/bake caller above.

iid_normal_scale_0p12_comparison.interpretation: A scale-0.12 iid fixture is not drawn from the official width-1024 law and is much higher-energy entrywise.

scaled_orthogonal_0p35_comparison.interpretation: A 0.35-scaled orthogonal/QR matrix is structurally and energetically unlike an official iid He matrix.

fixture_implications_for_q24.qualification_consequence: QR/orthogonal and scale-0.12 fixtures can remain algebra/parity stress tests, but neither is representative evidence for Q24/Q32 action on Phase-2 weights. The distribution-matched target-free comparator should materialize one deterministic width-1024/depth-16 stack through the exact pinned sample_mlp law, verify identical weight bytes are supplied to V4 and Q24, and store only prediction-difference/resource receipts.

catalog_manifest_observation.scope: Repository-tree manifest only. It lists the public dataset README and 67 full Parquet shards with content identifiers; no shard or dataset row was opened. The manifest does not itself specify the weight law and is not used to strengthen the generator claim.

caveats: The width=1024/depth=16 geometry is the supplied Phase-2 premise; this audit identifies the official generator conditional on that geometry.

The exact hidden board row bytes and their private bake receipt were not opened. Therefore this receipt proves the installed official evaluator/bake law and rules out alternate laws in that source, but does not claim a byte-level audit of the hidden corpus.

The standard-normal sequence is deterministic conditional on its SeedSequence stream; iid Gaussian describes the generator's sampling law, not a claim of mathematical independence for a fixed pseudorandom realization.
Float32 storage rounds the continuous Gaussian-scaled values, so N(0,2/1024) is the pre-cast sampling law.
